example.en: I cough a lot in the evening.
I have a cold and I cough.

example.el: Έχω γρίπη και δεν πάω στη δουλειά.
example.en: I have the flu and I am not going to work.

example.el: Πάρτε το σιρόπι τρεις φορές τη μέρα.
example.en: Take the syrup three times a day.

example.el: Το κέντρο υγείας είναι κοντά στο σπίτι μου.
example.en: The health centre is near my home.

example.el: Αύριο έχω εξέταση στο κέντρο υγείας.
example.en: Tomorrow I have a check-up at the health centre.
The pharmacist is in the pharmacy.

prompt.el: Πόσες φορές τη μέρα παίρνει η Αϊσέ το σιρόπι;
prompt.en: How many times a day does Ayşe take the syrup?
prompt.tr: Ayşe şurubu günde kaç kez alıyor?

explain.en: The pharmacist says «Πάρτε το τρεις φορές τη μέρα». Twice a day is for the pills.
explain.tr: Eczacı «Πάρτε το τρεις φορές τη μέρα» diyor. Günde iki kez hapları alıyor.

statements.el: Η Αϊσέ πηγαίνει αύριο στη δουλειά.
Ο γιατρός δίνει στην Αϊσέ μια συνταγή.
statements.en: The doctor gives Ayşe a prescription.

statements.el: Το χάπι της Αϊσέ είναι για το στομάχι.
statements.en: Ayşe's pill is for the stomach.

explain.en: She has a fever (both dialogues) and the doctor gives her a prescription. The doctor tells her to stay in bed, not to go to work. The pill she asks for at the pharmacy is «για τον πυρετό», for the fever.
explain.tr: Ateşi var (iki diyalogda da) ve doktor ona reçete veriyor. Doktor yatakta kalmasını, işe gitmemesini söylüyor. Eczanede istediği hap «για τον πυρετό», ateş içindir.

ask.en: Ayşe, ___ the syrup, please. (Nikos is speaking to his friend.)

prompt.en: Ayşe, ___ the syrup, please. (Nikos is speaking to his friend.)

explain.en: One friend gets the singular instruction in -ε: πάρε. πάρτε is for several people or a polite «you»; πήρα is the past («I took»).
explain.tr: Tek bir arkadaşa -ε ile biten tekil emir verilir: πάρε. πάρτε birkaç kişi ya da nazik «siz» içindir; πήρα geçmiş zamandır («aldım»).

text: {1} στο κρεβάτι. {2} το στόμα σας. {3} πολύ νερό.

translation.en: Lie down on the bed. Open your mouth. Drink plenty of water.
translation.tr: Yatağa uzanın. Ağzınızı açın. Çok su için.

explain.en: The doctor speaks politely, so all three are plural forms in -τε / -είτε: ξαπλώνω → ξαπλώστε, ανοίγω → ανοίξτε, πίνω → πιείτε. Only «το στόμα σας» fits «open».
explain.tr: Doktor nazik konuşuyor, bu yüzden üçü de çoğul biçim: ξαπλώνω → ξαπλώστε, ανοίγω → ανοίξτε, πίνω → πιείτε. «Το στόμα σας» yalnızca «aç» ile uyuyor.

explain.en: The plural instructions: έρχομαι → ελάτε, βλέπω → δείτε, λέω → πείτε, τρώω → φάτε, μπαίνω → μπείτε. Each verb has its own form.
explain.tr: Çoğul emirler: έρχομαι → ελάτε, βλέπω → δείτε, λέω → πείτε, τρώω → φάτε, μπαίνω → μπείτε. Her fiilin kendi biçimi var.

prompt.el: Πώς ζητάω ευγενικά το χάπι από τον φαρμακοποιό;
prompt.en: How do you politely ask the pharmacist to give you the pill?

explain.en: In a positive instruction the pronoun comes after the verb: Δώστε μου. «Μου δώστε» puts it in front. «Δώστε με» uses με (me), but «to me» is μου.
explain.tr: Olumlu emirde zamir fiilden sonra gelir: Δώστε μου. «Μου δώστε» zamiri öne koyuyor. «Δώστε με» ise με (beni) kullanıyor; «bana» μου demektir.

prompt.el: Αϊσέ, μην … το σιρόπι με καφέ!
prompt.en: Ayşe, don't ___ the syrup with coffee!

explain.en: After μην comes the 2nd person of the once-only stem, as after να: μην πάρεις. Never μην + the instruction form (πάρε), and the past (πήρες) does not fit an instruction.
explain.tr: μην sözcüğünden sonra, να'dan sonraki gibi, bir kerelik kökün 2. kişisi gelir: μην πάρεις. μην + emir biçimi (πάρε) olmaz; geçmiş zaman (πήρες) da bir emre uymaz.

ask.en: Sort each sentence into the right group. The first group is for one friend (εσύ), the second for a polite «you» or several people (εσείς).
ask.tr: Her cümleyi doğru gruba koy. İlk grup tek bir arkadaş (εσύ), ikincisi nazik «siz» ya da birkaç kişi (εσείς) içindir.

rubric.el: Βάζω κάθε πρόταση στη σωστή ομάδα.
rubric.en: Sort each sentence into the right group. The first group is for one friend (εσύ), the second for a polite «you» or several people (εσείς).
rubric.tr: Her cümleyi doğru gruba koy. İlk grup tek bir arkadaş (εσύ), ikincisi nazik «siz» ya da birkaç kişi (εσείς) içindir.

explain.en: -ε (and one-syllable πες) is for one friend: διάβασε, φέρε, πες. -τε is for several people or a polite «you»: πάρτε, ελάτε, καθίστε.
explain.tr: -ε (ve tek heceli πες) tek bir arkadaş içindir: διάβασε, φέρε, πες. -τε birkaç kişi ya da nazik «siz» içindir: πάρτε, ελάτε, καθίστε.

translation.en: μιλάω → θα μιλήσω → (you, polite) speak, please.

explain.en: The stem of θα μιλήσω plus -τε gives μιλήστε, with the stress just before -τε. (The singular is μίλησε.)
explain.tr: θα μιλήσω kökü + -τε = μιλήστε; vurgu -τε ekinden hemen önce. (Tekil: μίλησε.)

explain.en: «Κύριε» is a polite «you», so the plural form: μπαίνω → θα μπω → μπείτε. μπες is for a friend.
explain.tr: «Κύριε» nazik «siz» demek, o yüzden çoğul biçim: μπαίνω → θα μπω → μπείτε. μπες bir arkadaş içindir.

translation.en: Doctor, tell me please: is it the flu?
translation.tr: Doktor, söyleyin bana lütfen: grip mi?

explain.en: «Tell me» is πείτε μου: the pronoun for «to me» comes after the instruction. με would mean "me" as an object («listen to me»), and εγώ is the subject form.
explain.tr: «Bana söyleyin», πείτε μου demektir: «bana» zamiri emirden sonra gelir. με «beni» demek olurdu («beni dinleyin»); εγώ ise özne biçimidir.

explain.en: Positive instruction → μην/μη + 2nd person, with the pronoun back in front of the verb. πάρτε is plural (πάρετε); the others are singular (δώσεις, πεις, φας, κλείσεις).
explain.tr: Olumlu emir → μην/μη + 2. kişi; zamir fiilin önüne döner. πάρτε çoğul (πάρετε); öbürleri tekil (δώσεις, πεις, φας, κλείσεις).

prompt.el: Πώς λέω στη μητέρα μου να μην ανοίξει το παράθυρο;
prompt.en: How do you tell your mother not to open the window?

explain.en: To one person you know well: μην + 2nd person singular. «Μην άνοιξε» uses the instruction form and «μην ανοίξτε» the plural instruction; neither is allowed after μην.
explain.tr: Yakından tanıdığın tek bir kişiye: μην + 2. tekil kişi. «Μην άνοιξε» emir biçimini, «μην ανοίξτε» çoğul emir biçimini kullanıyor; ikisi de μην'den sonra olmaz.

text: Έχω πυρετό, αλλά {1} δε βήχω. Θέλω να έρθω, αλλά {2} δε νιώθω καλά. Δεν καταλαβαίνω· μιλήστε {3}, παρακαλώ. Το παιδί έχει πυρετό σαράντα! Τηλεφωνήστε {4} στον γιατρό!

translation.en: I have a fever, but fortunately I don't cough. I want to come, but unfortunately I don't feel well. I don't understand; speak slowly, please. The child has a fever of forty! Phone the doctor at once!
translation.tr: Ateşim var ama neyse ki öksürmüyorum. Gelmek istiyorum ama maalesef kendimi iyi hissetmiyorum. Anlamıyorum; yavaş konuşun, lütfen. Çocuğun ateşi kırk! Doktoru hemen arayın!

explain.en: Good news takes ευτυχώς, bad news δυστυχώς. Slow speech needs αργά, and an emergency needs αμέσως.
explain.tr: İyi haber ευτυχώς, kötü haber δυστυχώς alır. Yavaş konuşma αργά ister, acil durum αμέσως.

explain.en: Adjective in -ος → adverb in -α, with the stress on the same syllable.
explain.tr: -ος ile biten sıfat → -α ile biten zarf; vurgu aynı hecede kalır.

text: Με πονάει {1} κεφάλι μου. Με πονάει και {2} λαιμός μου, αλλά όχι {3} πλάτη μου.

translation.en: My head hurts. My throat hurts too, but not my back.
translation.tr: Başım ağrıyor. Boğazım da ağrıyor, ama sırtım ağrımıyor.

explain.en: The article follows the body part: το κεφάλι (neuter), ο λαιμός (masculine), η πλάτη (feminine).
explain.tr: Artikel vücut parçasına uyar: το κεφάλι (nötr), ο λαιμός (eril), η πλάτη (dişil).

prompt.el: Είστε στο φαρμακείο. Έχετε πυρετό και βήχετε. Τι λέτε στον φαρμακοποιό;
prompt.en: You are at the pharmacy. You have a fever and you cough. What do you say to the pharmacist?
prompt.tr: Eczanedesin. Ateşin var ve öksürüyorsun. Eczacıya ne dersin?

options: Δε νιώθω καλά. Έχω πυρετό και βήχω.

explain.en: You describe how you feel: δε νιώθω καλά, έχω πυρετό, βήχω. The other two use an instruction or μην where you should simply say what is wrong.
explain.tr: Nasıl olduğunu anlatırsın: δε νιώθω καλά, έχω πυρετό, βήχω. Diğer ikisi, derdini söylemen gereken yerde emir ya da μην kullanıyor.
